app.name: CHCKR
app.tagline: Is that forward true? Check it in your own language.

welcome.title: Check any forward before you share it
welcome.point1: Share a WhatsApp forward, photo, video or link to this app
welcome.point2: We check it with trusted news sources and fact-checkers
welcome.point3: You get the answer in your language, to read or to listen
welcome.privacy: Your photos and videos are deleted within 24 hours. We keep only the claims and verdicts, without any personal details, so others with the same forward get an answer faster.

home.pasteLabel: Paste the forward or a link
home.pastePlaceholder: Paste the message text or a link here…
home.howToShare: How to check a WhatsApp forward
home.step1: Add this app to your home screen (menu ⋮ then 'Install app')
home.step2: In WhatsApp, long-press the message and tap Share

check.title: Checking your forward
check.leaveNote: You can leave this screen. We will notify you when the answer is ready.
check.failed: Sorry, we could not finish this check. It did not count against your daily limit.
